shortDescription: Queries and returns elements from Nautobot GraphQL endpoint

options.name: graph_variables
options.description: Dictionary of keys/values to pass into the GraphQL query, see (U(https://pynautobot.readthedocs.io/en/latest/advanced/graphql.html)) for more info

options.name: query
options.description: The GraphQL formatted query string, see (U(https://pynautobot.readthedocs.io/en/latest/advanced/graphql.html)) for more details.

options.name: token
options.description: The API token created through Nautobot, optional env=NAUTOBOT_TOKEN

options.name: update_hostvars
options.description: Whether or not to populate data in the in the root (e.g. hostvars[inventory_hostname]) or within the 'data' key (e.g. hostvars[inventory_hostname]['data']). Beware, that the root keys provided by the query will overwrite any root keys already present, leverage the GraphQL alias feature to avoid issues.

options.name: url
options.description: The URL to the Nautobot instance to query (http://nautobot.example.com:8000), optional env=NAUTOBOT_URL

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether or not to validate SSL of the Nautobot instance
